$comment: Plan 04 §5. Every package fails the coverage job below its line or branch floor. The floors sit two points under the lower of the first two full CI measurements (2026-11-14; three points for the cloud adapters, measured once), because coverage moves a few points between runs with what each job contributes; they stop coverage slipping. SourceFlow.Tool and SourceFlow.Testing were raised on 2026-11-14 once tests/CodeCoverage.settings.xml stopped a sample child process from hiding the CLI tests' hits and left generated code out (Tool 95.8/82.1, Testing 94.2/77.6). Raise them as tests are added, towards the plan's goals: SourceFlow.Net 90/85, Generators 90/85, Testing 85/75, PostgreSQL 90/80, SqlServer 90/80, EntityFrameworkCore 85/75, the cloud adapters 85/75, AspNetCore 90/80, Tool 80/70, Studio 90/85.
